data.title: Everyday Chemistry Counting
data.description: Count atoms in familiar reactions that happen all around us every day.

equations.realWorld: Hydrogen fuel cells combine hydrogen and oxygen to generate clean electricity in modern buses.
Chefs combine reactive elements to create the seasoning we put on our food.
Old bicycles left out in the rain slowly develop a reddish-brown flaky coating on their metal frames.
Blue flames dance on a kitchen stove burner when cooking dinner.
